name: @1broseidon/hotline-harness-core
// private: hotline ships as one signed binary from hotline.dev/install.sh; there is no registry in the distribution story. The harnesses are built from source in this repo and loaded by explicit path (HOTLINE_CLAUDE_SDK_ENTRY, or pi's extension path), so nothing here is meant to be published. private:true makes that structural — npm refuses to publish it — rather than a thing someone has to remember.
description: Shared plumbing for hotline's TS harnesses (pi, claude-sdk): hotline-run child management, JSONL JSON-RPC framing, inbound envelope extraction, async queue, session persistence, auth report, logging. Zero runtime dependencies.
author: 1Broseidon

scripts.// prepare/prepack: Every export in this package points at dist/, which is gitignored. Without a build hook a clean checkout resolves them to nothing (workspace consumers fail to import) and `npm pack` ships a package with no code in it. prepare covers install-from-a-clean-tree, prepack covers publish; both are the same build.
